diagnosis: Browser serial, UNO firmware loop, and PCA9685 I2C detection are working. Since TESTALL is accepted and no physical servo moves, the most likely failure is servo rail power, missing shared ground, servo plug orientation, or a bad/unpowered servo.

changes: Connect is disabled while the page already owns a serial connection.
Disconnect explicitly releases reader, writer, and serial port handles.
Forget Port attempts to forget active and browser-granted serial ports.
Protocol buttons now show selected state.
New raw PCA9685 servo profiles inherit 100-650 range after smooth protocol selection.
Added PCA Status, I2C Scan, and Test All Channels controls.

firmware_update.upload_result: uploaded to COM5 after the Lab page was hard-refreshed/released
firmware_update.next_action: Verify the PCA9685 servo V+ rail has external servo power, confirm servo supply ground is tied to PCA9685/UNO ground, confirm servo plug orientation, then retest with TESTALL.

mim_training_lesson: When RX OK, PONG, PCA9685 FOUND 0x40, I2C 0x40, and TESTALL OK are present but no servo moves, MIM must stop asking about software and move directly to servo V+ rail power, shared ground, plug orientation, and known-good servo checks.
